title: The Diwali rush (EP36: GPUs and AI chips)
label: EP36

lines.text: Twenty-three orders waiting, and you're still typing a single reply?!
lines.show: 23 orders waiting, and you're still typing a single reply?!
lines.tts: Twenty-three orders waiting, and you're still typing a single reply?!

lines.text: Every word I write [1] takes over a billion multiplications.
lines.show: Every word I write takes over a billion multiplications.

lines.text: Then hurry up! This phone has eight cores!
lines.show: Then hurry up! This phone has eight cores!

lines.text: Eight workers, a billion calculations. [1] I need thousands.
lines.show: 8 workers, a billion calculations. I need thousands.

lines.text: Like my Diwali stock count? Every kid counting one rack?
lines.show: Like my Diwali stock count? Every kid counting one rack?

lines.text: Exactly. A G P U: the graphics card from games. [1] Thousands of small cores, all at once.
lines.show: Exactly. A GPU: the graphics card from games. Thousands of small cores, all at once.
lines.tts: Exactly. A G P U: the graphics card from games. [1] Thousands of small cores, all at once.

lines.text: But ten helpers can't write one bill faster. [1] Can more cores speed up a single reply?
lines.show: But ten helpers can't write one bill faster. Can more cores speed up a single reply?
lines.tts: But ten helpers can't write one bill faster. [1] Can more cores speed up a single reply?

lines.text: On our laptop: one core, eleven and a half seconds. <pause 0.7> [1] Four cores: under four. [2] Each word's work gets split.
lines.show: On our laptop: 1 core, 11.5 seconds. 4 cores: under 4. Each word's work gets split.
lines.tts: On our laptop: one core, eleven and a half seconds.
lines.tts2: Four cores: under four. Each word's work gets split.

lines.text: Twenty-three orders? Still a minute and a half! [1] Do I buy a graphics card?
lines.show: 23 orders? Still a minute and a half! Do I buy a graphics card?

lines.text: For Chat G P T, no. That runs on theirs. [1] For me, here: a gaming laptop's G P U, over three thousand cores.
lines.show: For ChatGPT, no. That runs on theirs. For me, here: a gaming laptop's GPU, over 3,000 cores.
lines.tts: For Chat G P T, no. That runs on theirs. [1] For me, here: a gaming laptop's G P U, over three thousand cores.

lines.text: For AI, count the workers, not their speed.
lines.show: For AI, count the workers, not their speed.

lines.text: Now the big brain! Not the squeezed copy, the full one!
lines.show: Now the big brain! Not the squeezed copy, the full one!

lines.text: Full size, it's fifteen gigabytes. [1] The card holds eight.
lines.show: Full size, it's 15 GB. The card holds 8.
lines.tts: Full size, it's fifteen gigabytes. [1] The card holds eight.

lines.text: It has to fit in the card. [1] The rest goes back to the eight workers. <pause 0.6> [2] Typing...
